title: The Little Giant Muay Thai

services.name: Adult Muay Thai
services.desc: Kru Chon is the best! Not only do the coaches at Little Giant provide great workouts, they also focus on actual combat skills. And, the coaches really care about their students. I wish I could give more than 5 stars! Our son has loved his time at the Littlegiant Muay Thai. Very professional and a great learning environment. This probably the most authentic Muay Thai establishment in Northern Virginia! Kru Chon is extremely patient, and genuine. He takes his time, and always has knowledge to give. 10/10 hands down the best Muay Thai gym I've been to! If you want to get fit or get into actual fighting, then this is the gym for you!
